title: GNSS: L76K Zephyr build validation + PMTK configuration follow-ups
description: Follow-ups from sxvf (driver skeleton landed untested): (1) Build validation — gnss_emul native_sim build with an l76k DTS overlay aborts on PRE-EXISTING Kconfig warnings-as-errors in that suite (THREAD_ANALYZER/STACK_CANARIES choice warnings + MODEM_BACKEND_UART direct-deps warning), independent of the new driver; needs either a gnss_emul prj.conf fix (prj.conf already selects those) or a dedicated twister scenario with CONFIG_UART_INTERRUPT_DRIVEN=y satisfied (native_sim serial deps). (2) PMTK init script (PMTK314 GGA/RMC-only output, PMTK220 1Hz rate, GNSS search mode) as a modem_chat init script. (3) Hardware validation on T-Echo with real L76K output (parent epic child project-LICHEN-2h1i.1.2.2). Driver files: lichen/drivers/gnss/gnss_l76k.c, lichen/dts/bindings/gnss/quectel,l76k.yaml, Kconfig GNSS_L76K + CMake registered.
